reviews.author: Zealous Blue
reviews.text: I contacted various fence companies and obtained multiple estimates. Cody arrived at my property on schedule and attentively listened to my requirements. I received a professional and competitively priced estimate in a timely manner, which fell within the range of other estimates I had obtained. I selected ABC Fence due to their integrity, professionalism, and commitment to completing the project. If you are seeking an affordable yet durable and well-constructed fence and gate with a warranty, I highly recommend choosing ABC Fence and Deck. You will not be disappointed. They demonstrate professionalism, care, and meticulous attention to detail. Cody and his team did an outstanding job on our wooden privacy fence, and I am extremely satisfied. We discussed our specifications, and they constructed the exact fence and 12-foot gate we desired. The project was completed in a day and a half, which was significantly faster than anticipated. I strongly recommend choosing ABC Fence & Gate.

reviews.author: Samantha Wcislo
reviews.text: We hired ABC for the repair and expansion of our deck. They also installed our fence. Both were done beautifully! Their attention to detail, professional and friendly communication, quality and safety standards, talented craftsmanship, and workday efficiency are absolutely unmatched!! With their fair and honest price scale I am literally searching for more projects around our home to re-hire ABC for many more jobs to come. You cannot go wrong in hiring them! You owe it to yourself and your home to inquire their talent. THANK YOU ABC!

reviews.author: judson Gauf
reviews.text: Cody and his crew were absolutely amazing! The guys didn’t miss a beat and went above and beyond. Genuinely can’t recommend them enough to anyone.

reviews.author: Kimberly Andlton
reviews.text: ABC Fence and Deck did a fantastic job on my front porch. Im in love with the new look! Thank you Cody Louk you did a great job!

reviews.author: Paul Arrington
reviews.text: Cody and his team did a great job installing our new privacy fence. He was upfront and honest with his pricing. And called me during the installation to give me status updates. He and his team worked late to stick to the original timeline that was quoted before the project. Cody is clearly knowledgeable in his trade and shared a lot of information about care, upkeep, maintenance, and just general product knowledge. I would highly recommend them to anyone needed their services.

reviews.author: Shamika Dirtion
reviews.text: Awesome company! Great fence install. Very prompt and professional. Every step of the process I received communication on dates and information about materials. I appreciate this team for helping me clear some unwanted branches and twigs growing where my old fence was. I appreciate them for not installing my new fence with them. That was an added bonus that made my yard look much cleaner with the new fence. I recommend 10/10! Thank you so much!

reviews.author: Queen Moomba
reviews.text: They installed a wooden fence at one of my properties and they did such a wonderful job I wanted to hire them again. They came out and installed a vinyl fence for our personal house! It was a lot of work but his team was extremely proficient and professional!

reviews.author: John Geary
reviews.text: Great company with great prices! The work is top quality an we are so happy with our deck and roof on our garage! We will use them for any future projects, Highly recommend

reviews.author: KIMBERLY CARR
reviews.text: Definitely recommend ABC fence and deck. They came out for an estimate, very reasonable, and were always quick to communicate.
